This '''skirmish''' took place in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] on the [[Floating Mountain]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. After the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] traveled to the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] to retrieve the [[Crystal Cloak]] stolen from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] [[Galactic Standard Calendar|years]] earlier, the [[Gracca]] used the cloak to create a forest of giant [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]. When Warrick brandished a stick at the Gracca and demanded the return of the cloak, the Gracca simply turned the stick into [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] and tossed it aside. The Gracca then flew at the Ewoks, attempting to turn them into crystal, but Kintaka used her [[Grappling hook/Legends|lasso]] to remove the cloak, which fell into the lava below the mountain. The Gracca then flew at Wicket, but accidentally flew into one of the crystals in his forest. The crystals collapsed on top of him, incapacitating him. The Ewoks then flew back to Bright Tree Village on their [[Hang-glider/Legends|skin gliders]].
